topic_en: Rust variables: let, mut and shadowing

xhs.title: Rust 变量为什么默认不能改？
xhs.body:
第 2 课：let、mut 和 shadowing
默认不可变 → 改了直接编译报错
要改值：加 mut
要换类型：用 shadowing 再 let 一次
你更常用 mut 还是 shadowing？评论区聊聊～

douyin.title: 一分钟搞懂 Rust 的 let 和 mut
douyin.body: 默认不可变，要改加 mut，换类型用 shadowing。

tiktok.body: Rust variables can't change by default. Add mut to change the value, use shadowing to change the type.

linkedin.title: Why Rust variables can't change by default
linkedin.body:
let: immutable by default, and the compiler stops any reassignment.
let mut: you opt in to change, so readers see which values move.
Shadowing (let x again): a new variable that can even change type.
Do you reach for mut or shadowing more often?
